Description: Freeware Advanced Audio FAAC is an LGPL-licensed, dependency-free AAC encoder and decoder suite with a resampler and MP4 muxer. It targets high-throughput media pipelines and constrained devices where footprint, speed, and quality all matter. . Key Features . - Codecs: MPEG-4 AAC-LC, HE-AAC v1 (SBR), and HE-AAC v2 (PS) encoding and decoding. - Formats: 8 kHz to 96 kHz sample rates, mono up to 7.1 multichannel. - Rate control: VBR, ABR, and CBR. - Embedded-ready: No external dependencies; compile-time feature gating keeps binaries small.
